name: P1 adminmech droid
description: The P1 adminmech droid was a model of adminmech droid that could have white or orange colored plating. They had two stocky legs supporting a frustum-shaped body with a flat, tapered head. In 10 BBY, one P1 adminmech droid was forced to fight in the droid arena of the establishment known as the Lodge on the planet Vandor.
